title: "Destined Pact"
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji gripped the blood-stained Jade Slip tightly, his mind already calculating—he needed to find the lost Chen family bloodline to break this inescapable死局.

text.content: Intense pain surged from his dantian to every limb, Chen Ji knelt on one knee, cold sweat beading on his forehead. The fragment suspended in his Mental Sea trembled violently, golden runes swimming along his meridians like living creatures—each rune passing felt like being branded by a hot iron. He bit his tongue hard, forcing himself to stay conscious—fainting now would be tantamount to handing over his life.

dialogue.content: "It comes." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul manifested from the fragment, his ethereal gaze showing rare solemnity. "The eighth page's inheritance... it shouldn't open at this time."

text.content: Before Chen Ji could press for answers, an ancient and majestic voice suddenly exploded in his mind, as if traversing endless ages. That voice carried no emotion whatsoever, yet each word was as heavy as mountains: "Chen bloodline, shall fulfill Heaven's Mandate—this is the Pact, unalterable." As the voice fell, a vast scroll suddenly unfolded in his Mental Sea.

Within the scroll, figure after figure knelt before the Heavenly Mandate's will. Their faces were blurred, but the blood coursing through their veins was clear—those were the ancestral faces of the Chen family. Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. He saw the first ancestor to sign the pact drenched in blood, yet still smiling, as if this were not a death pact but supreme glory.

dialogue.content: "The Chen lineage, generation after generation as Heaven's chess pieces, executing Heaven's will and orchestrating all beneath the sky." The transcendent voice spoke again. "Heavenly Fate Value is your foundation for existence, also the anchor of this Pact—when depleted completely, that is when the bloodline ends."

text.content: Chen Ji felt a bone-penetrating chill. He finally understood why every Chen descendant who possessed the Tianji Record met untimely ends—this was not a curse, but a pact. Every point of Heavenly Fate Value consumed was accelerating the Chen bloodline's extinction. And he himself was merely the newest piece in this inescapable game of chess.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng remained silent for a long while before slowly speaking: "What you now see is the original text of the Pact... every word, every clause, are shackles." His voice was low. "But when this old one followed your father, I heard him mention—this Pact is not entirely without flaws."

text.content: Chen Ji lifted his head abruptly, his eyes flashing with sharp light. His greatest talent was finding opportunity within despair—if this pact truly had no solution, why would his father have bothered with such intricate arrangements? The scroll slowly unfurled further, revealing more terms: each generation of direct Chen bloodline must bear the destiny of being a chess piece in Heaven's game, until Heavenly Fate Value reaches zero and the bloodline is severed.

However, at the very end of the Pact, a line of extremely faint small characters caught Chen Ji's attention—deliberately concealed by generations of Chen people, nearly merged into the Void. He focused intently, and his heart suddenly missed a beat: "Branch lineage mutation may sustain the main bloodline's vitality—but requires the Heaven's Mandate's Original Source as catalyst."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji stared at those nearly vanished characters, his mind racing at lightning speed. This sentence revealed two key pieces of information: First, the Chen bloodline was not limited to just his branch; Second, if he could find the lost bloodline, perhaps he could extend his own life. But the cost—heaven's Mandate's Original Source—would be his own fundamental power.

choices.description: Burn spiritual sense to forcibly trace more Pact details, even if it damages his foundation
choices.visible_cost: Consuming spiritual sense may lead to splitting headaches
choices.visible_reward: Obtained key information about the Pact
choices.risk_hint: Spiritual sense damage may affect subsequent plans

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth and activated his spiritual sense, forcefully probing deeper into the Pact. Agonizing pain instantly swept through his entire body, he groaned, blood trickling from his nose. However, the moment those small characters fully manifested, his breath suddenly stopped—following "Branch lineage," a name was赫然刻着: "Chen Nian."

choices.description: Mo Xiansheng followed his father for years, perhaps he knows the whereabouts of the Chen family's branch lineage
choices.visible_cost: May require paying an additional price
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng may not necessarily be forthcoming

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's expression shifted slightly, his illusory form actually trembling slightly. "Your father... when he sent your sister away back then, it wasn't merely to protect her." His voice was hoarse. "Chen Nian is a fusion of branch and main bloodlines—her blood is... different from ordinary people."

choices.description: The Pact's details are numerous, acting rashly may fall into a trap
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily abandon the chance to learn more
choices.visible_reward: Stay alert, avoid being deceived by the Pact

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. He didn't act rashly; instead, he repeatedly chewed over every clause of the Pact in his mind. This very caution made him notice a lethal detail—the Pact said "branch lineage may sustain the main bloodline," but it never specified whether the branch lineage must remain alive.

Chen Ji's fingertips trembled slightly. Why would his sister's name appear in this ancient Pact? He racked his brains but couldn't understand, yet the answer seemed to be on the tip of his tongue—Chen Nian being taken by the Holy Sect wasn't just because she was a "Destined Lock," but because she herself was part of this Pact.

Mo Xiansheng seemed to see through his confusion, sighing: "Back then, your father discovered that transplanting branch bloodline into the main bloodline's body could temporarily slow the consumption of Heavenly Fate Value. However, transplantation requires a 'Lock'—a medium that resonates with the Heavenly Mandate's will." His gaze fell on Chen Ji. "Your sister was born with extraordinary gifts. Her existence interferes with the Tianji Record's foresight... This is why her visions are always blurry."

dialogue.content: "So..." Chen Ji's voice was hoarse. "Father sent her away because he feared someone would use her to threaten me?" He clenched his fists, his knuckles white. "Or was he simply using her all along?"

text.content: Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment. "Your father's choices are not for this old one to judge. But one thing is certain—if Chen Nian falls into the Hands of Heaven's Eye, it will not hesitate to refine her into a Life-Extension Elixir, completely draining her bloodline power." His voice suddenly dropped lower. "At that point, not only will you be unable to save her, you yourself will be devoured by the Pact."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji found himself in a dilemma. The Pact hung over his head like a sword, ready to fall at any moment. And his sister Chen Nian, was both the key to breaking his chains and possibly the trap that would drag him into the abyss. He needed to make a choice.

choices.description: Since the Pact mentions a branch lineage, perhaps other Chen family members still exist in this world
choices.visible_cost: Need to leave the Tianqing Sect, exposing his whereabouts
choices.visible_reward: Find another path besides Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: Other Chen family members may have long been eliminated by Heaven's Eye

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, rapidly searching through the memory fragments his father left within his Mental Sea. After a long while, he opened his eyes, a flash of sharp light flickering within. "Father once mentioned, at the northern border there is a Chen family ancestral shrine... perhaps there are still clues about the branch lineage there."

choices.description: Since the Pact was established by the Heavenly Mandate's will, there must be exploitable loopholes
choices.visible_cost: Requires long-term study, may miss the best timing to save Chen Nian
choices.visible_reward: The possibility of completely breaking the Pact's shackles
choices.risk_hint: Heaven's Eye may detect and intervene at any moment

text.content: Chen Ji redirected his gaze to the original text of the Pact. This time, he no longer focused on those dazzling major clauses, but stared fixedly at the four characters "bloodline severed"—if both main and branch bloodlines were to perish simultaneously, would the Pact automatically become invalid due to losing its subject? This thought was crazy and dangerous, yet it showed him a glimmer of hope.

choices.description: Rather than waiting passively, take the initiative to attack and break the rules of this game
choices.visible_cost: May provoke Heaven's Eye's direct annihilation
choices.visible_reward: Overturn the entire game in one stroke, remake the rules
choices.risk_hint: With his current strength, a direct confrontation would be like an egg striking a rock

dialogue.content: "On what grounds?" Chen Ji suddenly laughed coldly. "On what grounds must the Chen family be chess pieces for generations? On what grounds must my sister be used as a Lock? On what grounds—" His voice suddenly dropped low, a resolute gleam flashing in his eyes. "I refuse to accept fate."

text.content: Just then, that transcendent voice spoke again, but this time with an added chill: "Chen child, all that you think, I know." Chen Ji's hairs stood on end—that voice seemed to pierce directly into the depths of his Mental Sea. "The Pact is sealed, how could it be altered? If you dare attempt to defy Heaven..."

dialogue.content: Before the voice could finish, the Tianji Record fragment in Chen Ji's Mental Sea suddenly erupted with blinding golden light, and an elderly voice, utterly different from that transcendent one, rang out: "Enough." That was the voice of the Tianji Record itself—or rather, the remnant will left by the being who created this treasure.

text.content: "This Pact... is not Heaven's Eye's original creation." The elderly voice slowly said. "Its blueprint comes from an even more ancient era." Chen Ji's pupils constricted; he felt a flood of memories surge into his mind—information fragments accumulated by generations of Tianji Record inheritors, now all being unsealed at this moment.

Within this torrent of information, Chen Ji glimpsed a startling truth—Heaven's Eye was not the original master of this realm; it was merely an外来意识 that descended ten thousand years ago. It needed a vessel to control this world, so it chose the Chen bloodline and signed this Pact riddled with loopholes. And those so-called "loopholes" were actually backdoors deliberately left by the first Tianji Record's master.

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record master's remnant will opened a door for Chen Ji, but also posed a choice. Inheriting this will meant a complete break with Heaven's Eye, while refusing meant continuing to be a chess piece at someone's mercy.

choices.description: Inherit the first Tianji Record master's will, confront Heaven's Eye head-on
choices.visible_cost: Completely become Heaven's Eye's focal target
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete Tianji Record inheritance and the accumulated knowledge of all past inheritors
choices.risk_hint: Heaven's Eye may annihilate him before he grows strong enough

text.content: Without hesitation, Chen Ji mentally recited his acceptance within his heart. The elderly voice let out a long laugh: "Good! This old one has waited for this moment for far too long." As the words fell, the Tianji Record fragment suddenly blazed with dazzling light, new content rapidly forming page after page—that was the lifelong心血 condensed by the first master.

choices.description: First digest existing information, don't rush into making an irreversible choice
choices.visible_cost: May miss the chance for deep resonance with the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Maintain room for maneuver, avoid exposing intentions too early
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Record master may think him lacking in courage

dialogue.content: A flash of approval appeared in Mo Xiansheng's eyes: "Steadiness—this is the quality your father lacked." He said softly, "This old one advises you not to spread word of this for now—Heaven's Eye may not have detected what just transpired."

text.content: When the light faded, Chen Ji found himself still sitting cross-legged in the quiet chamber, as if that earth-shaking upheaval had merely been a dream. Yet the page of golden characters now present in his Mental Sea clearly told him—this was all real. The eighth page of the Tianji Record was finally complete.

He took a deep breath and studied the page intently. What it recorded was not cultivation techniques or secret arts, but a roster—a list of "Prophets" selected by Heaven's Eye throughout the ages, who had perished for various reasons. At the very end of the list, two names were赫然 written: "Chen Xuan" and "Chen Ji." His father's name stood beside his own, and after "Chen Ji" there was a blank space, waiting to be filled.

dialogue.content: "It seems... I haven't been crossed off yet." Chen Ji self-deprecatingly smiled, yet a cold gleam flickered in his eyes. "Then there's still a chance." He firmly committed the list to memory, then stood up and pushed open the quiet chamber's window. Night was ink-black, stars dim, only a faint blood-red glow pierced the eastern horizon—that was the direction of Heaven's Eye's gaze.

text.content: Chen Ji gripped the blood-stained Jade Slip—that was the communication token left by the first strategist of the Prince's mansion. Beside the name "Chen Xuan" on the list, a location was marked: Northern Border, Chen Family Ancestral Shrine. He suddenly understood his father's layout—perhaps from the very beginning, he had been waiting for Chen Ji to reach this point.

A black shadow suddenly swept past outside the window. Chen Ji frowned slightly but didn't move. After a moment, a slip of paper floated through the window crack and landed in his palm. Only four characters were written on it, the brushwork cold and fierce: "Su Qingyao has noticed." He sighed softly and reduced the paper to ashes. It seemed that Inner Disciple Senior Fellow had not given up her investigation of him.

"Chen Family Ancestral Shrine..." Chen Ji murmured, complex lights flickering in his eyes. There were not only clues about the branch bloodline hidden there, perhaps also his father's final legacy left for him. But the northern journey was long, and Heaven's Eye's eyes would surely line the route. He needed to strategize, needed cover, and most importantly, needed a foolproof plan.

dialogue.content: He turned back to the desk, lifted his brush and dipped it in ink. Where the brush fell was an seemingly ordinary letter—表面上 merely requesting leave from the sect for a few days, but secretly, using code only specific people could understand, it quietly spread in multiple directions. Ye Qing, Su Qingyao, even Han Lie far away at the Xuanwu Sect—these chess pieces would all come into play in the game to come.

text.content: Having done all this, Chen Ji closed his eyes again, his consciousness sinking into the Tianji Record within his Mental Sea. The complete content of the eighth page was slowly emerging—a map marking the Chen Family Ancestral Shrine's location, and a hidden space surrounded by重重禁制. Deepest in the map, an uncanny rune was drawn, matching the Lock symbol on Chen Nian's body precisely.

"Branch lineage mutation may sustain the main bloodline's vitality—but requires the Heaven's Mandate's Original Source as catalyst." Chen Ji softly repeated the Pact's clause, suddenly laughing aloud. He finally understood why his father had insisted on sending Chen Nian away back then, and why he had desperately left these clues before dying. Not exploitation, not abandonment, but a father's final opportunity for his son to turn the tables.
Chen Ji gripped the blood-stained Jade Slip tightly, his mind already calculating—he needed to find the lost Chen family bloodline to break this inescapable死局.
